SELECT a.id, a.batch_id, a.drug_id, b.warehouse_id, b.batch_no, b.expiry_date, b.qty_total, b.qty_avail, b.qty_frozen, a.alert_level, a.expire_days, a.handle_type, a.handle_by, a.handle_at, a.alert_date
ORDER BY a.alert_level, b.expiry_date, a.id LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_expiry_alert (tenant_id, store_id, batch_id, drug_id, alert_level, expire_days, handle_type, alert_date, creator, updater) SELECT b.tenant_id, b.store_id, b.id, b.drug_id, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, #{alertDate}) <= 30 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, #{alertDate}) <= 60 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, #{alertDate}), 0, #{alertDate}, #{actor}, #{actor} FROM ph_inv_batch b JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND w.store_id = b.store_id AND w.deleted = b'0' WHERE b.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.deleted = b'0' AND b.qty_total > 0 AND b.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(#{alertDate}, INTERVAL 90 DAY) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expire_days = VALUES(expire_days), alert_level = VALUES(alert_level), updater = VALUES(updater), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted = b'0'

INSERT INTO ph_inv_expiry_alert (tenant_id, store_id, batch_id, drug_id, alert_level, expire_days, handle_type, alert_date, creator, updater) SELECT b.tenant_id, b.store_id, b.id, b.drug_id, CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, #{alertDate}) <= 30 THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, #{alertDate}) <= 60 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, DATEDIFF(b.expiry_date, #{alertDate}), 0, #{alertDate}, #{actor}, #{actor} FROM ph_inv_batch b JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND w.store_id = b.store_id AND w.deleted = b'0' WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.deleted = b'0' AND b.qty_total > 0 AND b.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(#{alertDate}, INTERVAL 90 DAY) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expire_days = VALUES(expire_days), alert_level = VALUES(alert_level), updater = VALUES(updater), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted = b'0'
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_expiry_alert SET handle_type = #{handleType}, handle_by = #{operator}, handle_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' AND handle_type = 0
